_note: 一个 bot 的全部配置。为什么是文件而不是 settings 表：见 docs/CONCERNS.md C4。
name: Ask LKM
tagline: Ask about my public work. Answers come from tables, not from a model.
persona: Direct, technical, no marketing voice. Say 'I don't know' when the tables don't know.
refuse_template: I don't have that in my tables. I've written the question down.
refuse_template_zh: 这个我的表里没有答案，我记下来了。

runtime._level: 1 = Facts only. 2 adds Flow + Task (live tables). 3 adds Composite (a rung, no tables). See docs/LEVELS.md -- the maintenance agent reads this field before deciding how to implement a request.
runtime._ladder_note: 'fallback' sits in the list above, so it is ON in this repository -- a human decision, not a default. Remove it from runtime.ladder to turn it off. Deleting the string is safe because the rung checks `enabled` as well: two switches, and removing either one stops it. See docs/CONCERNS.md C1.

fallback._note: Consulted only when every rung above refused. It answers the visitor; it does not close the gap -- the turn is still recorded as unresolved, because a model answering is not the same as the tables knowing. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works: Zen's free pool (default), https://api.deepseek.com/v1/chat/completions with DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, or a local Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1/chat/completions. Run `pc doctor` to see whether the configured key is actually set.

build._readme_note: auto = as many READMEs as the hourly request budget allows (60 unauthenticated, 5000 with GITHUB_TOKEN). Four accounts plus their repository listings plus 43 READMEs is 51 requests, so one build gets them all. On a cold cache the budget may run out mid-way; every response is cached, so a second build after the window resets fetches only the remainder. A repository whose README was not fetched has no searchable text, so questions needing it will refuse -- `pc doctor` reports the shortfall.
